scenario: `!~` must have zero captures per LREG.2.4 — a `where` clause with `e.msg !~ /^ERROR:/` (capture-free) compiles OK, pinning the zero-capture rule for negated match.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule not_error:
    Log e where e.msg !~ /^ERROR:/
->
    log info "not an error"
